title: Quota guard
summary: Protects your plan's quota: agents close to their limit aren't used, and runs that take too many steps or tokens are stopped.
usage: Always on. An agent whose plan limit is at 95% or more isn't used, and another agent takes over. A request opens at most 12 agent calls, and a run stops after 400 tool steps or about 1.5 million tokens. When something is stopped, the chat says why, and the agent's work stays. Plan limits are in Statistics.
